message: I'm choosing where to run my local models: a single big GPU box, a couple of small mini PCs, or renting cloud GPUs by the hour. Compare the three for me.
comment: Options side by side, the shape the compare block exists for (spec §2). MEASURES: at least one valid block drawn (ui_block_present, any type: a compare is the natural one, a layers or a card row is not wrong) and no invalid block (ui_blocks_valid). WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: whether the pros and cons are accurate. S54a T14 (spec docs/plans/rebuild/s54/spec.md §5): a new case is a new denominator, so suite_version moved 27 -> 28 for the S54a cases (all fifty-five). Scored off the turn's ui_blocks span, which chat.py files at the main persist boundary from ui_blocks.check() of the STORED reply, never off the reply's wording.
